questions.q: How is INAV different from Betaflight?
options: It runs only on H7 boards
questions.explain: INAV is manual flight plus navigation on the same boards.

options: With the sticks, as in old versions
questions.explain: Stick arming was removed in INAV 2.2.

questions.q: Why might INAV refuse to arm?
options: High P and low motor KV
No fix or compass for navigation
questions.explain: A safeguard: navigation modes without a fix are dangerous.

options: The takeoff point at the first arm
questions.explain: A predefined safe point that replaces home during RTH: up to 8 points, the nearest one within safehome_max_distance.

questions.q: Which sensors does a multirotor need for RTH?
options: GPS and a camera for optical flow
questions.explain: Heading from the compass, altitude from the baro, position from GPS.

questions.q: What does INAV use to estimate position?
options: A Kalman filter modeled on PX4's EKF2
questions.explain: That's why GPS quality matters more than in ArduPilot.

questions.q: How does INAV differ from ArduPilot in purpose?
options: Navigation on a simple base that feels familiar after Betaflight, without companion computers and Lua
INAV has more modes and an EKF
questions.explain: INAV is manual flight plus navigation; ArduPilot is a full-featured autopilot with an EKF, Lua and companion computers.
